lead: Test of 0.8.36 (CI test build 41194611708). risk.py: class C on all three systems, so from the core list only the automated runs (hil: cold start, reopen, export). The round's own items: section locking (#21), the ? menu (help mode with pinned and hover notes, Save Logs, Panic), Undo/Redo, Compare, Randomize and the RAM backup. Linux was checked with dev builds during the round; Windows and the Mac have seen nothing of this round yet. Mark each item, add a note where something looks different, then copy the results at the bottom into the chat.
rules: Order: Linux first (the Virus is on this PC), then the Windows VM, then the Mac. Close the DAW before the Virus moves.
Never power-cycle the Virus while it is attached to the VM; switch it off and on only while it is on Linux.
Use a disposable project. SAVE only into a RAM slot you can spare: TI Revive backs it up first ('RAM Backup (date)' in Personal Libraries).

sections.title: Linux
sections.where: REAPER, Virus on this PC, CI build 0.8.36 (installed with install.sh)
prep: Claude installs the CI build and runs hil.sh (cold start, reopen, export, broker killed while playing).

items.title: The round's features on the CI build
steps: ? menu: Explain the Controls, click a control (note stays), hover others (on top), hover the filter display in the cutoff knob; Save Logs writes a file; Panic.
Right-click where there is no control: Undo/Redo after a knob turn (also Ctrl+Z), Compare on and off, Randomize Medium with one section locked.
items.expect: As with the dev build: notes, menu entries and shortcuts work; the locked section keeps its values.

items.title: Download entire bank in REAPER
steps: Browser, right-click a RAM bank: Download entire bank from Virus TI. Wait up to about 2 minutes.
items.expect: The bank's names fill in. (Under our test host it got no answer, E380 (4): is that the test host or a bug?)

sections.title: Windows 11 (VM)
sections.where: win11 VM, Ableton Live 11, CI build 0.8.36 (installed silently by Claude)
prep: Claude installs the build in the VM, attaches the Virus and copies the hil-windows kit.

items.title: hil-win on the new build
steps: Run hil-win.cmd (about 5 minutes); Claude grades the result folder on Linux.
items.expect: Cold start, reopen and export pass (drift in the VM is not judged, E334).

items.title: Section locking (#21)
steps: Double-click a blue section header (e.g. Filter 1): it turns red. Load other patches from the browser and with the Virus' own program buttons.
Right-click a header: Unlock all Sections.
items.expect: The locked section keeps its values on every patch change; Unlock all Sections clears the red headers.

items.title: ? menu and help mode in Live
steps: ? menu: Explain the Controls, click a control, hover others; Save Logs for a Bug Report (save to the Desktop); Panic while a note hangs or plays.
items.expect: Clicked note stays, hover note on top; the log file is written; Panic stops the notes.

items.title: Undo, Compare, Randomize, RAM backup
steps: Turn a knob, Ctrl+Z in the editor (Live may take the key: then use the right-click menu); Compare on and off; Randomize Medium.
SAVE the part into a spare RAM slot, then drag that slot's entry from 'RAM Backup (date)' back onto the slot.
items.expect: Undo takes the turn back; Compare switches and returns; Randomize changes the sound in one step; the old patch is back in the slot.

sections.title: macOS
prep: Claude pushes the CI package to the Mac (INSTALL-COMMAND.txt and 'Install test build.command' in the unpacked folder); you run the installer, then hil-mac.command. The Mac must be awake for the push.

items.title: hil-mac on the new build
steps: Run hil-mac.command from the unpacked folder's hil folder (about 5 minutes) and send the result folder.

items.title: Section locking (#21)
steps: Double-click a blue section header: it turns red. Load other patches from the browser and with the Virus' program buttons; right-click a header: Unlock all Sections.
items.expect: The locked section keeps its values on every patch change; Unlock all Sections clears the red headers.

items.title: ? menu, Undo, Compare, Randomize
steps: ? menu: Explain the Controls (click, hover), Save Logs (Desktop), Panic.
Turn a knob, Cmd+Z in the editor (or the right-click menu); Compare on and off; Randomize Medium.
items.expect: Same as on Linux; the log file is written.

items.title: RAM backup
steps: SAVE the part into a spare RAM slot, then drag that slot's entry from 'RAM Backup (date)' back onto the slot.
items.expect: The backup library has the old patch; after the drag the slot plays it again.
